caption:
Wrote the IIM B UGAT? This is exactly how IIM Bangalore decides who gets an interview, straight from IIMB's own admissions document 👇

1. Clear every cut-off. General: VARC 50, LR 50, QADI 75 and 80 overall (percentiles). And your raw score must be positive in all 3 sections.
2. Pre-interview score out of 100: UG Test 70, Class 10 overall 15, Class 10 maths 10, gender diversity 5.
3. Final score: UG Test 40, interview 40, Class 10 overall 10, Class 10 maths 10.

Yes, your Class 10 maths marks count twice. And the interview counts as much as the test.

Results are expected on 15 Dec (tentative). Check your raw score now: register.ipmcareer.com/response-v1
